meaning:
1) to use the tongue, slander
1a) (Poel) to slander
1b) (Piel) to slander
1c) (Hiphil) to accuse

elsewhere.note: I will silence whoever secretly slanders his neighbor. I won’t tolerate one who is arrogant and conceited.
“Don’t slander a servant to his master, lest he curse you, and you be held guilty.
